note: Every guide step cites a source. Steps marked from the official description are derived from the trophy text itself; confirmed details come from PowerPyx and the guide sites listed. Two trophies (44, 49) are still unconfirmed by every source and are flagged.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn all 54 other trophies and the platinum unlocks automatically. Follow the roadmap: story first, then the collectible and activity trophies, then the grind trophies.

steps.text: The platinum unlocks the moment the other 54 trophies are earned; there is no separate task.
Work the roadmap in order: finish the story, then sweep collectibles and activities, then grind the counters.
Track progress on this page; the sticky bar shows X / 55 and the next unearned trophy.
Watch the one possibly missable trophy (Positive Mental Attitude, id 28) before the story ends.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission Gone Fishing; it is the first story mission and cannot be missed.

steps.text: Gone Fishing is the opening story mission; it starts automatically when a new game begins.
Follow the on-screen objectives through the mission until the completion screen.
The trophy pops when the mission completes; no optional objective is required.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 1; the trophy pops at the chapter end.

steps.text: Play through Chapter 1 in story order; the chapter ends after its final mission.
Side activities are not required for the chapter trophy, only the story missions.
The trophy unlocks at the Chapter 1 completion screen.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 2; the trophy pops at the chapter end.

steps.text: Play through Chapter 2 in story order; the chapter ends after its final mission.
Only the story missions count toward the chapter trophy.
The trophy unlocks at the Chapter 2 completion screen.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 3; the trophy pops at the chapter end.

steps.text: Play through Chapter 3 in story order; the chapter ends after its final mission.
Only the story missions count toward the chapter trophy.
The trophy unlocks at the Chapter 3 completion screen.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 4; the trophy pops at the chapter end.

steps.text: Play through Chapter 4 in story order; the chapter ends after its final mission.
Only the story missions count toward the chapter trophy.
The trophy unlocks at the Chapter 4 completion screen.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission; it is the last mission in the game and the gold pops on completion.

steps.text: The final mission unlocks after the last chapter's story missions are done.
Complete the final mission's objectives to the end; there is no branching requirement.
The gold trophy pops at the final mission completion screen.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Breakfast Run when it appears in the mission list.

steps.text: Breakfast Run appears as a story mission; start it from the mission marker.
Complete the mission objectives; the trophy is tied to finishing the mission, not to a rating.
The trophy pops when the mission completes.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission The Cartel Heist when it appears in the mission list.

steps.text: The Cartel Heist appears as a story mission; start it from the mission marker.
Complete the heist objectives to the end; the trophy is tied to finishing the mission.
The trophy pops when the mission completes.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Child's Play when it appears in the mission list.

steps.text: Child's Play appears as a story mission; start it from the mission marker.
Complete the mission objectives; the trophy is tied to finishing the mission, not to a rating.
The trophy pops when the mission completes.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Headliners when it appears in the mission list.

steps.text: Headliners appears as a story mission; start it from the mission marker.
Complete the mission objectives; the trophy is tied to finishing the mission, not to a rating.
The trophy pops when the mission completes.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission VCIA Takedown when it appears in the mission list.

steps.text: VCIA Takedown appears as a story mission; start it from the mission marker.
Complete the mission objectives; the trophy is tied to finishing the mission, not to a rating.
The trophy pops when the mission completes.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Operation Savage Glory when it appears in the mission list.

steps.text: Operation Savage Glory appears as a story mission; start it from the mission marker.
Complete the mission objectives; the trophy is tied to finishing the mission, not to a rating.
The trophy pops when the mission completes.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion: finish the story, all stranger strands, all collectibles, all activities and all challenges. The in-game stats page tracks the percentage.

steps.text: 100% completion counts story missions, stranger strands, collectibles, activities and challenges together.
Finish the full story first; story progress is the largest single chunk of the percentage.
Complete all 8 stranger mission strands; each strand adds completion percentage.
Collect every collectible set: cards, and any other set the stats page lists.
Try every activity type once and finish the activity challenges the stats page tracks.
Finish 50 challenges; the challenge counter feeds the completion percentage.
Explore all 52 areas of Leonida; area discovery counts toward completion.
Check the in-game stats page for the exact percentage and the remaining categories.
Use the checklist on this page to tick off each category as you finish it.
The gold pops the moment the stats page reads 100%.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts. Jumps, near misses, drifts and airtime all count; farm them at a big jump or a long straight and use the stepper on this page to count.

steps.text: Any stunt counts: jumps, near misses, drifts, wheelies and airtime.
A single jump off a ramp or a highway jump can register several stunts at once.
Repeat the same jump: drive back, line up, and jump again; the counter keeps rising.
Near misses in traffic count too; weaving through highway traffic builds the total fast.
Drifting around corners counts; a long drift chain adds several stunts per corner.
The in-game stats page shows the stunt total; compare it with the stepper here.
Use the stepper on this page (0 / 250) to track the count as you go.
The silver pops at stunt 250; reaching the target auto-marks it earned here.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types once each: fishing, shooting range, drone racing, arcade, bowling, golf or minigolf if present, and the other open-world activities the map lists.

steps.text: There are 9 activity types; trying each one once earns the trophy.
Fishing counts as one type; catch anything once at a fishing spot.
The shooting range counts as one type; complete any one challenge there.
A Top Fun drone race counts as one type; finish any one race.
An arcade game counts as one type; finish any one game.
Bowling counts as one type; play a frame at the bowling alley.
Use the stepper here (0 / 9) to tick off each activity type as you try it.
The trophy pops when the ninth type is tried; no score or win is required.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold all 42 shooting range challenges. Learn each range's target pattern, use the right weapon for the range, and retry a challenge until the gold time/score lands.

steps.text: There are 42 shooting range challenges across the ranges; every one needs a gold medal.
Each challenge shows its gold threshold before you start; beat that number, not just the bronze.
Use the weapon the range hands you; switching weapons mid-challenge usually voids the attempt.
Aim for headshots on precision challenges; they score more per hit than body shots.
On timed challenges, reload during a lull, not while targets are up.
Replay a challenge as many times as needed; medals keep your best result per challenge.
Use the stepper here (0 / 42) to count the gold medals as you earn them.
The silver pops when the 42nd gold medal is earned.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Learn each course's gates, cut corners where the gates allow, and use boost on the straights.

steps.text: There are 14 Top Fun drone race locations across Leonida.
Each location has its own course; winning once per location is enough.
Fly through the gates in order; missing a gate costs more time than any shortcut saves.
Save boost for the long straights between gate clusters.
Use the stepper here (0 / 14) to count the locations you have won.
The trophy pops when the 14th location is won.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Each distinct race counts once; repeat wins on the same race do not add to the total.

steps.text: Only distinct races count; winning the same race twice adds nothing.
Races appear across Leonida: street, off-road and circuit events.
Pick a fast car for street races and an off-roader for dirt events.
Use the stepper here (0 / 20) to count the different races you have won.
The trophy pops at the 20th distinct race win.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fish at a challenge spot, match Cal's catch, and land the bigger fish to win.

steps.text: Cal issues fishing challenges at fishing spots; accept one to start.
Cast where the fish are biting; the water ripples show the best spot.
Reel steadily and ease off when the line strains, so it does not snap.
Land a bigger catch than Cal to win the challenge and the trophy.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game at any arcade cabinet. Any game counts; reaching its end screen is enough.

steps.text: Arcade cabinets are in arcades and some bars; walk up and start any game.
Play the game to its end screen; a high score is not required.
The trophy pops when the arcade game completes.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's stranger mission strand, then his final mission. Stranger strands unlock as you play the story.

steps.text: Andy's strand is a stranger mission chain; it unlocks during the story.
Complete each of Andy's missions in order; the strand marker shows the next one.
The final mission for Andy appears after the earlier ones are done.
The trophy pops when Andy's final mission completes.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's stranger mission strand, then his final mission. Stranger strands unlock as you play the story.

steps.text: Kenton's strand is a stranger mission chain; it unlocks during the story.
Complete each of Kenton's missions in order; the strand marker shows the next one.
The final mission for Kenton appears after the earlier ones are done.
The trophy pops when Kenton's final mission completes.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's stranger mission strand, then his final mission. Stranger strands unlock as you play the story.

steps.text: Billy's strand is a stranger mission chain; it unlocks during the story.
Complete each of Billy's missions in order; the strand marker shows the next one.
The final mission for Billy appears after the earlier ones are done.
The trophy pops when Billy's final mission completes.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete all 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Each strand is a chain of missions for one stranger; the map markers show where each strand starts.

steps.text: There are 8 stranger strands in total, spread across Leonida.
Stranger markers appear on the map as you progress the story; visit each one to start its strand.
Each strand is a chain; finish every mission in a strand to complete it.
Five of the strands end in named final missions (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone).
Use the stepper here (0 / 8) to count the strands you have completed.
The silver pops when the 8th strand completes.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's stranger mission strand, then his final mission. Stranger strands unlock as you play the story.

steps.text: Randy's strand is a stranger mission chain; it unlocks during the story.
Complete each of Randy's missions in order; the strand marker shows the next one.
The final mission for Randy appears after the earlier ones are done.
The trophy pops when Randy's final mission completes.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's stranger mission strand, then his final mission. Stranger strands unlock as you play the story.

steps.text: Tyrone's strand is a stranger mission chain; it unlocks during the story.
Complete each of Tyrone's missions in order; the strand marker shows the next one.
The final mission for Tyrone appears after the earlier ones are done.
The trophy pops when Tyrone's final mission completes.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. This is the one possibly missable trophy: do it before the story ends, because spots may become unreachable after the finale.

steps.text: There are 18 meditation spots across Leonida; each one is a quiet scenic point.
Walk up to a spot and use the meditate prompt; the spot counts once you finish meditating.
Spots are spread across Vice City, the Keys and the countryside; check the map for the markers.
This is the one possibly missable trophy: finish all 18 spots BEFORE the final mission.
Spots may become unreachable after the story ends, so do not leave this for post-game.
If a spot marker is missing, try it at a different time of day; some spots only show in daylight.
Use the stepper here (0 / 18) to count the spots you have meditated at.
The trophy pops at the 18th meditation spot.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. Bret marks the hunting area on the map; track the animal and take it down cleanly.

steps.text: Bret gives the hunt as a stranger mission; his marker shows the hunting area.
Track the animal by following its trail and signs in the area.
Use a scoped rifle for a clean kill; a messy kill can fail the hunt.
Return to Bret (or confirm the kill as the mission asks) to finish the hunt and the trophy.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are hidden across Leonida — in shops, on rooftops, in alleys and at landmarks; each set needs every card in that set.

steps.text: Cards are scattered across Leonida: shops, rooftops, alleys, beaches and landmarks.
Each card belongs to a set; a set only completes when every card in it is found.
Pick up a card by walking over it; the card name and set show on pickup.
Check the collection menu to see which cards in each set you still miss.
Cards in interiors need the building open; some only appear at certain story points.
Rooftop cards need a climb or a helicopter; use a nearby tall building to reach them.
Use the stepper here (0 / 3) to count the sets you have completed.
The silver pops when the 3rd set completes.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK It is the in-game check-in: open the app at a named location and check in; each distinct location counts once.

steps.text: WAiNK It is the in-game check-in app; open it at a named location to check in.
Each distinct location counts once; checking in twice at the same place adds nothing.
Locations span all 52 areas of Leonida, so explore widely.
Landmarks, shops, beaches and viewpoints all count as check-in locations.
The app shows which locations you have already checked in at.
Use the stepper here (0 / 100) to count the locations you have checked in at.
The silver pops at the 100th distinct check-in.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges cover combat, driving, flying and exploration; the challenge menu lists them all with their requirements.

steps.text: Challenges cover combat, driving, flying, stunts and exploration.
Open the challenge menu to see every challenge and its requirement.
Start with the easy ones (drive a distance, visit areas, do stunts) to build the count fast.
Combat challenges count kills and headshots; driving ones count races and stunts.
Each completed challenge adds one to the counter; there are more than 50 in total.
Use the stepper here (0 / 50) to count the challenges you have completed.
The trophy pops at the 50th completed challenge.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then escape. Build the wanted level with your partner present, then break line of sight and hide until it clears.

steps.text: Your partner must be with you when the wanted level is lost; do it during a mission or activity that keeps them nearby.
Raise the wanted level to 4 stars (shooting police, causing chaos) with your partner present.
Break line of sight: duck into an alley, a parking garage or the countryside.
Stay hidden until the stars flash and clear; the trophy pops when the 4-star level is fully lost.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Keep the wanted level alive between robberies: rob, move to the next shop, rob again, and do not let the stars clear.

steps.text: Your partner must be with you for all three robberies.
Rob the first shop (aim at the clerk, take the cash) to gain a wanted level.
Move straight to the next shop; do not wait for the wanted level to clear.
Rob the second shop, then the third, back-to-back with the wanted level still active.
If the wanted level clears between robberies, the chain breaks and you start over.
Use the stepper here (0 / 3) to count the back-to-back robberies.
The trophy pops after the third consecutive robbery.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Every distinct vehicle you drive or enter counts; the vehicle list in the menu shows which ones you have found.

steps.text: Every distinct vehicle you drive or enter counts toward the total.
Cars, bikes, boats, planes and helicopters all count as vehicles.
Parked cars on the street count when you enter them; traffic gives a steady stream of new ones.
Rare vehicles appear in specific places: dealerships, the airport, the marina and the countryside.
Check the vehicle list in the menu to see which ones you still miss.
Use the stepper here (0 / 100) to count the vehicles you have discovered.
The trophy pops at the 100th distinct vehicle.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Find a group of enemies, trigger Combat Focus, and chain the kills before the focus ends.

steps.text: Combat Focus is the slow-motion aiming mode; trigger it when several enemies are close.
Find a group of 5 or more enemies before triggering it, so the kills are available.
Aim for quick kills in sequence; the focus timer runs while you aim.
Use the stepper here (0 / 5) to count the enemies downed in one focus.
The trophy pops when the 5th enemy goes down inside a single Combat Focus.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA (the airport). Take a plane from the airport without following the normal departure — steal a plane and take off.

steps.text: VCIA is the Vice City airport; get onto the airfield.
Steal a plane on the runway or at a hangar.
Take off without clearance; the trophy pops once you are airborne on the unscheduled departure.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Deal with Rhinos (tanks). Get into a Rhino tank and use it — drive it and fire its cannon — to earn this one.

steps.text: Rhinos are the military tanks; they appear at the military base and in high wanted levels.
Get into a Rhino (steal one or enter an abandoned one).
Drive the Rhino and fire its cannon; the trophy pops once you have used it.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet, avoid the cameras and guards, take the jewels and leave before anyone raises the alarm.

steps.text: Pick a jewelry store; go in during quiet hours when fewer guards are around.
Avoid the security cameras and stay out of the guards' line of sight.
Take the jewels and leave without triggering the alarm; the trophy pops on a clean getaway.
If you are spotted, leave and try again; a detected attempt does not count.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time. Crack the vault, grab the cash, and lose the wanted level after each robbery; each successful vault adds one.

steps.text: Bank vaults are in banks across Leonida; enter a bank and reach its vault.
Crack the vault (follow the on-screen prompt) and take the cash.
Escape the bank and lose the wanted level after each robbery.
Each successful vault robbery and escape adds one to the counter.
Use the stepper here (0 / 5) to count the vaults you have robbed and escaped from.
The silver pops after the 5th vault robbery and escape.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Find a truck on the road, stop it, crack it open, take the cash and lose the wanted level.

steps.text: Armored trucks drive set routes around Leonida; spot one on the road.
Stop the truck (ram it or block it) so it cannot drive off.
Crack the truck open and take the cash inside.
Lose the wanted level after the robbery; the trophy pops on the escape.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. Drive, fly or sail into every named area; the map fills in as you visit each one.

steps.text: Leonida has 52 named areas, from Vice City to the Keys and the countryside.
Entering an area marks it explored; the map fills in as you go.
Drive the highways to cover the cities fast, then branch into the back roads.
Use a plane or helicopter for the islands and the far corners of the map.
Use a boat for the Keys and the coastal areas a road cannot reach.
Check the map for the areas still greyed out; those are the ones you have not visited.
Use the stepper here (0 / 52) to count the areas you have explored.
The trophy pops when the 52nd area is explored.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Each gang runs operations in its own territory; hit one operation per gang.

steps.text: There are 9 gangs in Leonida, each running illegal operations in its territory.
An illegal operation is a gang-run business (drugs, weapons, contraband); the map marks them.
Rob one operation per gang; robbing two operations of the same gang adds nothing.
Expect armed resistance at each operation; bring weapons and armor.
Use the stepper here (0 / 9) to count the gangs whose operation you have robbed.
The trophy pops after the 9th gang's operation is robbed.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED: no guide site has verified how this unlocks yet. The description says enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach — try a beach bar on Ocean Beach and order a cocktail there. Treat this as unconfirmed until a source verifies it.

steps.text: UNCONFIRMED by every source as of 2026-11-20; the unlock below is the best reading of the description, not a verified method.
Go to a bar on Ocean Beach with a sea view.
Order a cocktail there and drink it with the view; the trophy should pop if this is the trigger.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car through the showroom window to escape.

steps.text: Go to a vehicle showroom and get a car inside or near the entrance.
Drive the car through the showroom glass to smash out.
The trophy pops once you have smashed out of the showroom.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play bowling at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. Bowl a full game there (follow-through on your throws) to earn it.

steps.text: The Kolt & Associates bowling alley is the bowling venue; go inside.
Start a game of bowling and play through it.
The trophy pops when the bowling game at this alley is finished.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership moment with mass appeal. This is a story/partner moment; it unlocks by playing through a partner scene that the description points at.

steps.text: This is a partner-story moment; it unlocks through a scene with your partner.
Play the story until the partnership scene plays out.
The trophy pops when the scene completes.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make 500 choices. Choices are the dialogue and action decisions the game tracks; PSN tracks a count to 500, so keep choosing through the story and side content.

steps.text: The game tracks choices (dialogue and action decisions) and PSN counts them to 500.
Make choices whenever the game offers them; both options count.
Story missions offer the most choices; side content and stranger missions add more.
Use the stepper here (0 / 500) to count the choices you have made.
The trophy pops at the 500th tracked choice.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED: no guide site has verified how this unlocks yet. PowerPyx says it is currently unknown, believed related to the Payday Loans store from the Prologue. Try the Payday Loans store a second time. Treat this as unconfirmed until a source verifies it.

steps.text: UNCONFIRMED by every source as of 2026-11-20; PowerPyx believes it is related to the Payday Loans store from the Prologue.
Go to the Payday Loans store from the Prologue and try it a second time.
The trophy should pop on the second attempt if this is the trigger.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: CONFIRMED: witness the UFO. Go to the road northwest of Starlet Motel in Kelly County after 02:00, alone, and flash your car headlights; the UFO spawns there (somewhat random, so repeat if needed).

steps.text: CONFIRMED by PowerPyx: the UFO appears on the road northwest of Starlet Motel, Kelly County.
Go there after 02:00 at night; the UFO only shows in the early hours.
Go alone (no passenger) and in a car with headlights.
Flash your car headlights on the road to trigger the spawn.
The spawn is somewhat random; if nothing appears, drive away and try again.
Stay on the road and watch the sky; the trophy pops when the UFO is witnessed.
If it does not appear after several tries, try a different night; the spawn is random.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: CONFIRMED: on a motorbike or bicycle, kick 10 pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds, in Vice City / Ocean Beach. Ride along a busy sidewalk and kick pedestrians as you pass them.

steps.text: CONFIRMED by PowerPyx: use a motorbike or a bicycle.
Ride in Vice City or Ocean Beach, where the sidewalks are crowded.
Press Square to kick a pedestrian as you ride past them.
Kick 10 pedestrians within 60 seconds; the timer starts on the first kick.
Stay on the sidewalk line so pedestrians keep coming; do not stop between kicks.
If the 60 seconds run out, start over; the count resets.
The trophy pops on the 10th kick inside the 60-second window.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering marked bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from robberies and heists; launder them through a contact to convert them to clean cash, and the laundered total counts.

steps.text: Marked bills come from robberies, heists and vault jobs; they are dirty cash.
Launder marked bills through a contact; the contact converts them to clean cash.
Each laundering run converts a batch; the laundered total adds up across runs.
Bigger jobs give more marked bills per run; vaults and heists are the best source.
The in-game stats show how much you have laundered so far.
Use the stepper here (0 / 250000) to track the laundered total.
The trophy pops when the laundered total reaches $250,000.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buy clothes, weapons, cars, food and anything else in shops; the total spent counts across every shop.

steps.text: Every dollar spent in any shop counts: clothes, weapons, cars, food, ammo.
Expensive items count faster; a car or a weapon closes the gap quickly.
The total is cumulative across all shops, not per shop.
Use the stepper here (0 / 100000) to track the total spent.
The trophy pops when the total spent reaches $100,000.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Garages are for sale across Leonida; buy each one from its for-sale sign or the property app.

steps.text: There are 8 garage properties for sale across Leonida.
Buy each garage from its for-sale sign or through the property app.
Garages cost money; save up or launder marked bills to afford them.
Use the stepper here (0 / 8) to count the garages you own.
The trophy pops when the 8th garage is purchased.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Drive a vehicle, open the Scooter Bros app and register it; each distinct vehicle counts once.

steps.text: The Scooter Bros app registers vehicles you drive.
Drive a vehicle, open the app and register it; each distinct vehicle counts once.
Any vehicle counts: cars, bikes, trucks and more.
Use the stepper here (0 / 10) to count the vehicles you have registered.
The trophy pops at the 10th registered vehicle.
